findings.text: Ask 3 says "open the Timeline scrolled to its last row by scrolling the page", but `to_end()` does nothing when the list is not boxed (SessionTimeline.js, `boxed()`/`to_end()`), and its comment says the page is "never scrolled". On a phone the Timeline therefore opens at its oldest row, not the newest; the requirement was either to scroll the page to the end or to say why not.

The stats line shows poorly in `after-390.png`: cost reads "?", state reads "unknown", and the text is cut at "with child…" so the running time is never visible. The example in requirements.md was "$309 · $1325 with children · 5d". Check the line against a session with a resolved cost and trim the cost text so cost, state and running all fit (AISessionDetail/SessionStats.js, `.sov-line-cost` ellipsis in SessionOverview.css).

`public/framework/ai/AISession/readme.md` line 10 still lists the old tabs "Overview · Timeline · Board · Tasks · Chat, then Coverage, Cost…". It must say Overview · Timeline · Chat · Tasks · More ▾ (Board, Coverage, Cost, Models and tokens, Related, Task queue →, Full screen). Line 11 should also say Coverage reads the same prompt tail (`SessionTimeline.Tail`), and it should mention the one-line phone stats bar. The readme-as-structure rule (CLAUDE.md law 9) was missed.

The `session.jsonl` log says "Smoke run still going", and no smoke result (no FAIL) is recorded anywhere in the folder. `after-390.png` crops the tab row and title, so the "one line, 44 px" claim cannot be checked from a shot; the heights 39.5 and 44.4 px are asserted only in the log line.

`.sessions-tabs { flex-wrap: nowrap }` and the `.sessions-chip` nowrap rules sit outside the phone media query (SessionOverview.css, end of diff). With five chips this fits at 390, but a narrower phone or a larger font scale would clip the "More ▾" button off-screen instead of wrapping.

Popover content runs at `draw()`, so the More buttons exist from the start. That is why `show()` and `buttons.coverage.el.hidden` work unchanged, so no break here. But a comment saying so would stop a later edit from making the popover lazy and crashing `show()`.

answer.reply: declined: chosen on purpose (d244507a8). Scrolling the page to the newest row on a phone pushes the stats bar and the tab row off the first screen, and the owner's path is session → Overview → tab. So on a phone the Timeline opens at its oldest row with the tabs in view; on a wide screen the list's own box still opens at the newest row. The alternative, newest-first order on a phone, would win if the owner wants the latest event on the first screen; it is a one-line sort flag in SessionTimeline.draw.
